docs.title: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) on a local GPU, reachable over the LAN
docs.text: Runs qwen3.6:27b-coding on this machine's GPU through Ollama and serves the dsh web UI so other machines on the network can use it.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• Ollama installed. It uses the GPU automatically (Metal on macOS, CUDA on NVIDIA/Linux).
  • Node.js >=24.9.0. Check with node -v.
  • dsh installed: npx @deepseek-ai/dsh

docs.title: 0. install Node.js and dsh
docs.text:
curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.1/install.sh | bash
nvm install 22
nvm use 22

launch the webui 

npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web

docs.title: 1. Pull the model on the GPU and start ollama server
docs.text:
ollama pull qwen3.6:27b-coding
ollama serve

by default, it will use port 11434

  • using the OLLAMA_HOST env variable, we can specify a new port

  • this will however require us to point to the model list

OLLAMA_HOST=172.28.x.x:3000 OLLAMA_MODELS=/usr/share/ollama/.ollama/models ollama serve

docs.title: 2. Get this machine's IP
docs.text:
ipconfig getifaddr en0    # macOS
hostname -I               # Linux

Example used below: 172.28.70.132.

docs.title: 3. Start dsh bound to that IP
docs.text:
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web --host your_host_ip --port 3080 --trusted-host your_host_ip:3080 --no-open

--host must be a real interface address. 0.0.0.0 is rejected.

dsh prints a URL like:

dsh web: http://172.28.70.132:3080/?token=XXXXXXXX

docs.title: 4. Open it from another machine
docs.text: Open the printed URL, including ?token=..., in a browser on any machine on the same network. Without the token, access is denied.

docs.title: 5. Open the firewall if it does not connect
docs.text:
• macOS: System Settings > Network > Firewall > allow incoming connections for node.
  • Linux (ufw): sudo ufw allow 3080/tcp

docs.title: Security
docs.text: The token gives full control of the agent, which can run commands on this machine. Share it only with trusted people. Keep it on a trusted LAN or VPN (for example Tailscale). Do not port-forward 3080 to the internet.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
• UNKNOWN_MODEL ... "8bdf0bc645c4": in ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml, set agent-default-model > model: to "qwen3.6:27b-coding" (the name, not the ID from ollama list). Then restart dsh and start a new session.
  • Repeated [deepseek-account] ... 403 log lines: harmless when only Ollama is used.
